title: Future Investment Initiative 2026
body: The Future Investment Initiative (FII) is one of the world’s leading investment conferences, hosted annually in Riyadh. Organized by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), it gathers global leaders, investors, and policymakers to discuss future economic trends, innovation, and sustainable development. The event focuses on AI, ESG investments, infrastructure, and global capital flows.

title: LEAP 2026
body: LEAP is the largest tech event in the Middle East, hosted in Riyadh. Organized by Tahaluf and supported by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, the event focuses on AI, cloud, fintech, and digital transformation. It attracts startups, global tech companies, and investors.

title: Black Hat MEA 2026
body: Black Hat Middle East and Africa is the region’s largest cybersecurity event, bringing together security professionals, ethical hackers, and government leaders. The event includes training sessions, live demonstrations, and security briefings.

title: Saudi Infrastructure Expo
body: Saudi Infrastructure Expo showcases the Kingdom’s large-scale infrastructure projects aligned with Vision 2030. It connects contractors, investors, and suppliers across transport, utilities, and construction sectors.

title: Cityscape Global Riyadh
body: Cityscape Global is a major real estate and urban development exhibition focusing on Saudi Arabia’s mega projects, including NEOM and Red Sea developments.

title: Saudi Manufacturing Show
body: This event highlights Saudi Arabia’s industrial sector and manufacturing capabilities, supporting the 'Made in Saudi' initiative.

title: Global Health Exhibition KSA
body: A leading healthcare event connecting hospitals, providers, and investors across the Kingdom.

title: Saudi Tourism Forum
body: A platform for discussing tourism development, investments, and mega projects across Saudi Arabia.

title: MISA Investment Forum
body: Organized by the Ministry of Investment, this forum focuses on attracting foreign investors and promoting Saudi Arabia as a business destination.

title: GITEX Global Dubai
body: GITEX is one of the largest global technology exhibitions, attracting companies, startups, and governments.

title: Arab Health Dubai
body: Arab Health is the leading healthcare exhibition in the Middle East, bringing global medical professionals together.

title: Saudi Logistics Expo
body: A logistics-focused event supporting Saudi Arabia’s strategy to become a global logistics hub.

title: Riyadh International Book Fair
body: A cultural and business event supporting publishing, media, and knowledge sectors.

title: Saudi Smart Cities Summit
body: Focuses on smart infrastructure, IoT, and digital transformation in Saudi cities.

title: Digital Transformation Summit KSA
body: Brings CIOs and IT leaders together to discuss digital strategies and enterprise transformation.

title: Saudi Finance Expo
body: Focused on banking, fintech, and investment opportunities.

title: Middle East Energy Dubai
body: Energy exhibition covering oil, gas, and renewable energy.

title: Saudi HR Summit
body: A major HR and workforce event discussing Saudization and talent strategies.

title: Real Estate Future Forum
body: Discusses the future of real estate and investment in Saudi Arabia.

title: Saudi Industrial Development Forum
body: Supports industrial growth and investment in manufacturing.
